title: RecallEnvelopeV2
description: Replay-resistant AEON-IQ recall attestation. Language-neutral contract; the Rust implementation in crates/aeon_nexus_bridge is one conforming implementation and is proven against vectors/recall_envelope_v2/. Every optional key MUST be present with an explicit null when it has no value -- an absent key is invalid. Timestamps are integer milliseconds since the Unix epoch, never RFC 3339 strings. Scores are fixed-point integer micros; no floating-point value may appear anywhere in this document.
$comment: JSON Schema integer assertions use mathematical value semantics and do not enforce token spelling. Conforming consumers MUST perform the lexical number-token preflight in PROTOCOL.md section 4 and vectors/recall_envelope_v2/number_tokens.json before conversion to a generic JSON value or schema validation; every number token MUST match -?(0|[1-9][0-9]*).

canonicalUuid.description: Canonical lowercase hyphenated UUID, exactly 36 characters. `format: uuid` is deliberately NOT used: it is annotation-only in most validators and would accept uppercase, unhyphenated, braced and urn:uuid forms, which parse to the same value but produce different canonical bytes and therefore different signatures.

opaqueId.description: Stable opaque identifier. MUST NOT contain display names, email addresses, or other unnecessary PII.

hit.description: One ranked memory. provenance_digest and authority_label are per hit and are covered by the signature; null means no authenticated claim (AUTH_0).

rank.description: Zero-based and equal to this hit's index in hits.

score_micros.description: Signed 64-bit fixed-point micros. null means no score; it MUST NOT be replaced with 0.

expires_at_unix_ms.description: MUST be strictly greater than issued_at_unix_ms, and at most 120000 ms after it.

query_digest.description: SHA-256 over the exact UTF-8 query bytes, with no normalization.

limit.description: Requested cap. hits length MUST be <= limit. This is a request parameter, not a result count. A limit of 0 is rejected: a recall asking for nothing is not meaningfully attestable.

hits.description: Ordered. An empty array is valid and signable. memory_id values MUST be unique, and memory_version_id values MUST be unique.

signature.description: Detached signature over the bytes 'AEON_RECALL_ENVELOPE_V2' || 0x00 || canonical(payload).

algorithm.description: Frozen. An envelope does not get to nominate its own algorithm; an arbitrary string here is a downgrade vector.

signature.description: Lowercase hex, exactly 128 characters (64-byte Ed25519 signature).

signed_payload_digest.description: SHA-256 of the SIGNING BYTES (domain prefix included), not of canonical(payload) alone. public_recomputable MUST be true.

signing_domain.description: Declarative echo of the frozen domain label. Never caller-selectable; a mismatch MUST fail closed.
